# Third-party notices

`@surdeddd/liquidglass` has no runtime dependencies. One third-party library is bundled into the
distributed artifact and its notice is reproduced below.

## html-to-image

Bundled into the lazily loaded snapshot chunk used by the `webgl-overlay` backend. The chunk is
fetched only when that backend is selected, which happens when you request it explicitly or use
metaball merging.

- Version: 1.11.13
- Source: https://github.com/bubkoo/html-to-image
